concerns.text: FR-001 requires annotating failure cases with exactly one structural feature. Tasks T005b (Consensus Generation) and T005c (Resolve Disagreements) are marked incomplete. Without these, the pipeline cannot produce a valid labeled dataset required for FR-001 and US-1.

FR-002 requires a ≥90% rule coverage threshold on a held-out split. Task T011d (Implement Rule Coverage Validation & Gate) is marked incomplete. No other task implements this mandatory validation step.

Constitution Principle VI mandates explicit structural annotation. Task T005d (Provision Human Annotator Interface & Protocol) is incomplete. T009a (Annotation Logic) depends on it, blocking the entire P1 User Story.

FR-004 requires executing the baseline agent on 'standard resources' distinct from the rule engine. Task T058c (Configure CI Job Matrix for Dual Resource Profiles) is incomplete, leaving the infrastructure to isolate and run the baseline comparison missing.

SC-003 requires measuring the statistical significance of the interaction term (p < 0.05). Tasks T026a (Model Fitting) and T026c (Verify Interaction Term Significance) are incomplete, leaving the primary research question unmeasured.

FR-007 mandates categorizing failed pivots into 'Coverage Gap' or 'Distillation Error'. Task T027 (Implement Failure Categorization Logic) is incomplete, preventing the generation of the required error taxonomy evidence.

FR-004 and Constitution Principle VII require enforcing resource constraints. Tasks T007c1 (Memory Check Watchdog) and T007c2 (CPU Check Watchdog) are incomplete, meaning the system lacks enforced resource constraints.

T002c (Implement Reference-Validator Script) is marked incomplete. T002 (Reference-Validator Execution) depends on it. Without T002c, the mandatory constitutional gate for citation verification cannot be executed.
T005a (Implement Gold Standard Loader / Generator) is incomplete. This is required to support the Human-in-the-Loop Ground Truth process described in the Plan and Constitution Principle VI.
T054 (Implement Annotation Inter-Rater Reliability Check) is incomplete. The Plan explicitly requires 'Cohen's Kappa validation' for the annotation phase, which this task would implement.
